passage.text: There's a note from Mom on the kitchen table.
passage.reading: ðɛrz ə ˈnoʊt frəm ˈmɑːm ɑːn ðə ˈkɪtʃən ˌteɪbəl.

passage.text: Nam, please go to the convenience store after class.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈpliːz ˈɡoʊ tə ðə kənˈviːniəns ˌstɔːr ˈæftər ˈklæs.

passage.text: Please buy some eggs, cereal, and two bottles of water.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz ˈbaɪ sʌm ˈɛɡz, ˈsɪriəl, ənd ˈtuː ˈbɑːtəlz əv ˈwɔːtər.

passage.text: Fah wants a pack of instant noodles and some bread.
passage.reading: ˈfɑː ˈwɑːnts ə ˈpæk əv ˌɪnstənt ˈnuːdəlz ənd sʌm ˈbrɛd.

passage.text: The money is on the table, under my cup.
passage.reading: ðə ˈmʌni ɪz ɑːn ðə ˈteɪbəl, ˈʌndər maɪ ˈkʌp.
